source: Shiu et al. 2024 (Nature) whole-brain LIF model, FlyWire v783; annotations Schlegel et al. 2024

stimuli.label: Applause
stimuli.sub: Johnston's organ (JO) auditory/vibration neurons

stimuli.label: Snack break
stimuli.sub: sugar gustatory receptor neurons

stimuli.label: Heckler looms
stimuli.sub: LC4 looming-detector visual neurons

stimuli.label: Rotten tomato
stimuli.sub: bitter gustatory receptor neurons

stimuli.label: Smells bad ⚠
stimuli.sub: Or56a olfactory receptor neurons (geosmin). Warning: in this model it ignites self-sustaining runaway activity

stimuli.label: Walk drive
stimuli.sub: fictive: P9 descending neurons

stimuli.label: Turn-left drive
stimuli.sub: fictive: left DNa01 + DNa02

stimuli.label: Turn-right drive
stimuli.sub: fictive: right DNa01 + DNa02

stimuli.label: Back-up drive
stimuli.sub: fictive: moonwalker descending neurons (MDN)

stimuli.label: Reward (dopamine)
stimuli.sub: PAM dopaminergic neurons, driven by cheers, laughs and applause

stimuli.label: Punishment (dopamine)
stimuli.sub: PPL1 dopaminergic neurons, driven by boos and gasps

stimuli.label: Vocal drive
stimuli.sub: fictive: song/wing-power descending neurons DNg02 + DNp13

stimuli.label: Retch drive
stimuli.sub: fictive: pharyngeal-nerve motor neurons

stimuli.label: Fart drive
stimuli.sub: fictive: oviposition descending neurons (oviDN)

stimuli.label: Hearing: low band
stimuli.sub: JO-B antennal neurons (low-frequency sound/song), driven live by in-world audio (music, crowd, Leno)

stimuli.label: Hearing: high band
stimuli.sub: JO-A antennal neurons (high-frequency vibration), driven live by in-world audio

stimuli.label: Ambience: taste
stimuli.sub: low-rate noise on all gustatory neurons

stimuli.label: Ambience: touch
stimuli.sub: low-rate noise on mechanosensory neurons except the antennal JO

stimuli.label: Smell (left antenna)
stimuli.sub: fruit/vinegar odour receptor neurons of the left antenna (DM1-4, VA2)

stimuli.label: Smell (right antenna)
stimuli.sub: fruit/vinegar odour receptor neurons of the right antenna

stimuli.label: Taste: sugar
stimuli.sub: all sugar/water gustatory receptor neurons (food touched by legs/mouth)

readouts.label: Articulators
readouts.sub: mouthpart (MxLbN) + pharyngeal (PhN) motor neurons: Leno's 'vocal tract'
